class.name: OcgGeomapiProjectpointoncurve
class.brief_description: This class implements methods for computing all the orthogonal projections of a 3D point onto a 3D curve.
class.description: ! This class implements methods for computing all the orthogonal ! projections of a 3D point onto a 3D curve.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an empty object. Use an Init function for further initialization.

method.name: from_2
method.description:
Create the projection of a point

on a curve

method.name: from_3
method.description:
Create the projection of a point

on a curve limited by the two points of parameter Umin and Usup.

method.name: Init_1
method.description:
Init the projection of a point

on a curve

method.name: Init_3
method.description:
Init the projection of a point

on a curve limited by the two points of parameter Umin and Usup.

method.name: Init_2
method.description:
Init the projection of a point

on a curve limited by the two points of parameter Umin and Usup.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Performs the projection of a point on the current curve.

method.name: NbPoints
method.description: Returns the number of computed orthogonal projection points. Note: if this algorithm fails, NbPoints returns 0.

method.name: Point
method.description: Returns the orthogonal projection on the curve. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.

method.name: Parameter_1
method.description: Returns the parameter on the curve of the point, which is the orthogonal projection. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.

method.name: Parameter_2
method.description: Returns the parameter on the curve of the point, which is the orthogonal projection. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.-

method.name: Distance
method.description: Computes the distance between the point and its orthogonal projection on the curve. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.

method.name: NearestPoint
method.description: Returns the nearest orthogonal projection of the point on the curve. Exceptions: StdFail_NotDone if this algorithm fails.

method.name: LowerDistanceParameter
method.description: Returns the parameter on the curve of the nearest orthogonal projection of the point. Exceptions: StdFail_NotDone if this algorithm fails.

method.name: LowerDistance
method.description: Computes the distance between the point and its nearest orthogonal projection on the curve. Exceptions: StdFail_NotDone if this algorithm fails.
